transcript.text: How do you eliminate distraction? I
eliminate it by eliminating it. My
office has no outside light. I also put
on ear plugs and headphones. There's a
great app that like blocks your phone,
so like nothing can get through. Then
you have to physically move across the
building, which is how I do it for mine.
And then I just set a kitchen timer for
when I how long I expect a task to last.
Then I just have a clear idea of the
work that I need to do. That is when I'm
like peak productivity per unit of time
because there's nothing else to do.
